facts.fact: Research cited by the page states that retargeting ads can increase conversion rates by as much as 150%.
facts.quote: Research consistently shows that retargeting ads can increase conversion rates by as much as **150%**.

facts.fact: The page reports that 92% of marketers believe retargeting performs as well as or better than other ad strategies.
facts.quote: An overwhelming **92%** of marketers believe retargeting performs as well as or better than other ad strategies.

facts.fact: The page is dated December 11, 2025.
Adwave identifies households that have visited a business's website and shows them commercials on their smart TVs, per the vendor's description.
facts.quote: By identifying households that have visited a business's website, Adwave helps small businesses show commercials directly to interested customers on their smart TVs.

facts.fact: Retargeting uses signals such as a site visit or product view to select later ads, subject to the platform's privacy and consent requirements.
facts.quote: Retargeting uses signals such as a site visit or product view to select later ads, subject to the platform's privacy and consent requirements.

facts.fact: Pixel-based retargeting places a pixel on a website that drops an anonymous cookie in a visitor's browser, which ad networks use to show ads later.
facts.quote: When someone visits your site, the pixel drops an anonymous cookie in their browser.

facts.fact: List-based retargeting matches uploaded contact lists, such as CRM email addresses, to user profiles on platforms like Facebook Ads Manager and Google.
facts.quote: The platform then matches those email addresses to user profiles and shows your ads directly to those specific people.

facts.fact: Search retargeting targets people based on keywords they recently searched for online rather than prior website visits.
facts.quote: Instead of targeting people who have been to your website, you target them based on the keywords they've recently searched for online.

facts.fact: Adwave states it can serve retargeted commercials to households on Connected TV (CTV) apps and services.
facts.quote: Adwave can then serve them your commercial on their Connected TV (CTV) apps and services.

facts.fact: The page states that retargeting campaigns often see two to three times higher click-through and conversion rates, with no source cited.
facts.quote: these campaigns often see **two to three times higher** click-through and conversion rates

facts.fact: The page claims that applying the mere exposure effect through retargeting can boost brand recall by 57%, with no source cited.
facts.quote: This simple principle can boost brand recall by an impressive **57%**.

facts.fact: The page states that the global digital ad market hit roughly $733 billion in 2023, linking to seo.com for further digital marketing statistics.
facts.quote: The global digital ad market hit roughly **$733 billion** in 2023

facts.fact: The page states that customers are up to 70% more likely to convert when they see a retargeted display ad, citing seo.com.
facts.quote: customers are up to **70% more likely** to convert when they see a retargeted display ad.

facts.fact: The page gives an example frequency cap of five views per day for a retargeted ad, to keep the brand visible without becoming a nuisance.
facts.quote: Limiting how often someone sees your ad (say, **five times a day**) keeps your brand visible

facts.fact: The page says retargeting usually means serving display ads to anonymous people who have visited a site, while remarketing is more direct, such as emailing known contacts like someone who abandoned their cart.
facts.quote: retargeting** is usually about serving display ads to anonymous people who've visited your site. It's broad and based on their browsing activity.

facts.fact: The page says most retargeting platforms charge on a cost-per-click (CPC) or cost-per-thousand-impressions (CPM) model.
facts.quote: Most platforms work on a cost-per-click (CPC) or cost-per-thousand-impressions (CPM) model.

facts.fact: The page says smart advertisers use frequency caps to limit how many times one person sees their retargeting ad.
facts.quote: Smart advertisers use frequency caps to limit how many times one person sees their ad.

facts.fact: The page says a tracking pixel identifies website visitors so they can be shown retargeting ads on other websites, social media, and streaming TV until they convert or opt out.
facts.quote: When someone visits your website, a tracking pixel identifies them. You can then show them ads on other websites, social media, and now even streaming TV.

facts.fact: The page says small businesses need enough website traffic to retarget effectively, so they should build awareness first to drive traffic.
facts.quote: it only works if you have enough website traffic to retarget. Small businesses should build awareness to drive traffic first

facts.fact: The page states that Adwave targets only households that have already shown interest in a brand online when running local TV advertising (a vendor claim, not a measured figure).
facts.quote: By targeting only the households that have already shown interest in your brand online, Adwave makes sure your message is relevant
